entries.title: OpenAI Realtime live voice — words as you speak, all on your OpenAI key
bullets: Swapped Deepgram for OpenAI Realtime transcription (gpt-4o-transcribe over WebRTC). When you tap the mic, your words stream in live, word-by-word, then the clean final transcript lands in the box — the ChatGPT-voice feel, 100% OpenAI on your existing key.
The unified voice hook prefers live and falls back to record-then-transcribe (gpt-4o-transcribe) if Realtime can't connect — so voice never breaks.
Security: a short-lived ephemeral token is minted server-side by the new loren-realtime-token function, so your OpenAI key is never exposed to the browser.
Voice micro-crediting: every dictation logs a small metered charge (1 credit per started minute) to loren_agent_runs, so voice usage shows in Activity and counts in the credits ledger.
entries.bench: loren-realtime-token (ephemeral) · useLorenVoice WebRTC live → gpt-4o batch fallback · voice micro-credit logging · rebuild nudged
